scientific_integrity: The exact monomial moment identity is standard prior work; the claimed new content is the phase classification and essential-singularity optimizing scale. Numerical assertions supplement an analytical proof; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-weight large-symbol-degree operator norm and optimizing monomial degree; no uniform joint near-critical limit, no general radial weights, no Schatten norm optimization. Novelty against wider historical monomial Hankel literature remains provisional.
title: A boundary-to-bulk transition in high-power weighted Bergman Hankel norms
